notes: redis.io/careers/ 301s to /company/careers/; the listing page calls https://redis.io/api/careers/feed/ with start/end (page size 12) plus location, department and search. Live check: department=Marketing returned total=2 (both Marketing), and search=zzzznomatch returned total=0, so both filters are applied server-side. The page renders 12 cards with Load More; the full unfiltered feed returns all 31 postings.
